category_title: Infrequent communicators with one-word responses who tolerate but disengage from social interaction
minimal_context: The student and tutor are participating in a 1:1 interaction session using bubbles.
dialogue:
TUTOR: We are going to do a bubble lesson today. Look at the bubbles.

STUDENT: (Shows no interest in interacting with the adult and gives a one-word response) Bubbles.

TUTOR: Tell me what you want me to do with them.

STUDENT: (Takes the highly motivating item from the table to work away on his own agenda) Open.

TUTOR: Give the bubbles back to me right now. You need to sit still and listen.

STUDENT: (Protests immediately following the directive communication and turns away, exhibiting ignoring behaviours) No!

options.A: Provides digital bubble apps that have instant rewards with audio and text.
options.B: Jokes a lot and laughs at themselves during the bubble lesson.
options.C: Breaks the bubble lesson activities into small chunks during the session.
options.D: Controls the access Charlie has to the bubbles during the session.
